more_info.overview: Lactitol is used as a thickener in food. Its technological role is to increase the thickness of food.
more_info.origin: Made by catalytic hydrogenation of lactose. Its starting material is the milk sugar lactose.
more_info.dietary_restrictions: The specified manufacturing process uses lactose. The specification does not identify the commercial lactose feedstock, so vegan and religious suitability cannot be established from it alone.
